description: This file implements responsive table functionality for Drupal, allowing tables to hide and show columns based on screen size with toggle controls.

classes.name: Drupal.TableResponsive
classes.description: A class that manages responsive behavior for tables, including toggling visibility of columns based on priority.

methods.name: TableResponsive
methods.description: Constructor function initializing responsive table behavior.

methods.name: eventhandlerEvaluateColumnVisibility
methods.description: Evaluates and updates the visibility of columns based on screen size.

methods.name: eventhandlerToggleColumns
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of low and medium priority columns when the user interacts with the toggle link.
